source_goal: Similar segments on the same proper chord and on the same side cannot be unequal; prove equality of the actual circular_segment_region sets.
interface: Two positive-radius circles through the same distinct endpoints; same side sign; are_similar_circular_segments supplies two actual chosen-arc vertices with equal ray angle.
forward_spine: Equal ray angles give equal normalized dot products x/h=y/k. Dot/determinant norm identities give h²=x²+u², k²=y²+v², where u and v have the same strict chord side.
The scalar normalized projection lemma proves x*v=y*u without division by a possibly zero cosine; right-angle/diameter case is included.
For each circle the checked chord-side identity is x*L=2*C1*u, y*L=2*C2*v. Since u*v>0 and L>0, deduce C1=C2.
Equal-radius distances to chord endpoints give the same center projection on the chord. Equal projection and equal signed determinant imply the two centers coincide.
Radius positivity and equal squared radius give equal radii, hence equal filled segment sets by identical definitions.
status: Independent strict file gate passed; canonical joint integration and proof audit pending
